description:
Update the primary facility details in LibreHealth EHR to match the new practice identity. Log in (admin/password), navigate to Administration > Facilities, and edit the main facility (currently 'Your Clinic Name Here' or similar). Update the record with these EXACT details:
- Name: LibreHealth Medical Center
- Federal EIN: 12-3456789
- Email: admin@librehealth.org
- Website: https://www.librehealth.org
- Phone: 555-0199

Ensure the 'Billing Location' checkbox is checked, then save the changes.
